notes:
Amarseba NID Verify 1.0.0 — first stable release.

- Pair the app with your Amarseba account and verify your NID profile
- Capture your verified profile straight from the NID portal
- Built-in self-update: the app checks for and installs newer versions

Install
- Android 8.0+: amarseba-nid-verify.apk
- Windows 10/11 (64-bit): amarseba-nid-verify-setup.exe
